sloka: यदीदम् मेऽनुरूपार्धं मया साधु सुमन्त्रितम् ।भवन्तो मेऽनुमन्यन्तां कथं वा करवाण्यहम् ॥२-२-१५॥
transliteration: yadīdam me'nurūpārdhaṁ mayā sādhu sumantritam ।bhavanto me'numanyantāṁ kathaṁ vā karavāṇyaham ॥2-2-15॥

translations.english: Although it (this decision) is personally favourable to me and I have decided after seeking good counsel, you should also give me your consent and tell me what I should do.
